description: Angular component for a hierarchical entities widget in the Thingsboard platform, managing entity nodes, their rendering, interactions, and data subscriptions.

classes.name: EntitiesHierarchyWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component for displaying and managing a hierarchical view of entities with search, expand/collapse, and data subscription features.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes widget settings, subscriptions, and configuration after component creation.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up reactive search input handling after view initialization.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions and resources when component is destroyed.

methods.name: onDataUpdated
methods.description: Updates node data based on new subscription data.

methods.name: onEditModeChanged
methods.description: Adjusts UI elements when edit mode state changes.

methods.name: initializeConfig
methods.description: Configures widget actions, node context functions, and CSS styling.

methods.name: enterFilterMode
methods.description: Enables text search mode and focuses search input.

methods.name: exitFilterMode
methods.description: Disables text search mode and resets search input.

methods.name: updateNodeData
methods.description: Updates node data and styles based on subscription data.

methods.name: loadNodes
methods.description: Loads child nodes for a given node or root.

methods.name: onNodeSelected
methods.description: Handles node selection events and triggers actions.

methods.name: onNodesInserted
methods.description: Handles insertion of new nodes and updates pending tasks.

methods.name: searchCallback
methods.description: Performs search filtering on nodes based on search text.

methods.name: updateNodeStyle
methods.description: Updates visual style and state of a node.

methods.name: prepareNodes
methods.description: Sorts and filters nodes before rendering.

methods.name: prepareNodeText
methods.description: Generates display text for a node, including icon.

methods.name: prepareNodeIcon
methods.description: Determines icon HTML for a node.

methods.name: datasourceToNode
methods.description: Converts datasource info into a tree node.

methods.name: loadChildren
methods.description: Loads child nodes for a parent node via subscription.

methods.name: prepareNodeRelationQuery
methods.description: Prepares relation query for a node.

methods.name: prepareNodeRelationsQueryFilter
methods.description: Creates filter for node relation query.
